title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for liver transplant.

HPI
Pt is a 75 y.o. female presenting for follow-up status post liver transplant. Pt reports mild abdominal discomfort and low-grade fever over the last 48 hours. Denies significant jaundice or severe pain. Labs and imaging were reviewed, showing elevated liver enzymes. Recent biopsy performed to evaluate suspected rejection. Biopsy results confirmed acute rejection.

Medication List
1. Prednisone 60mg daily
2. Tacrolimus 2mg BID
3. Mycophenolate mofetil 500mg BID

Exam
General: Alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 78, RR 16, Temp 99.1 F, SpO2 98% RA.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, no guarding.
Lungs: CTAB.
Heart: RRR.

Assessment
1. Acute rejection of the transplanted liver.

Plan
1. Increase steroid dose for acute rejection management.
2. Continue current immunosuppressive regimen.
3. Monitor LFTs and renal function.
4. F/u in 1 week for clinical re-evaluation.

Electronically signed, R. Mensah, DO, 05/12/2026
explanations: Rejection of a transplanted liver: liver transplant rejection, T86.41 (HCC 62); the complication code replaces the status code.

distractors.why: A complication (rejection) is documented: use T86.41.
